glossary.definition: A Japanese residence status for work in designated fields. Check the official field guidance for skills, Japanese-language requirements and any applicable exemptions.
A Japanese programme combining work and technical training. Confirm the current framework, eligibility and any transition arrangements through official guidance before considering a placement.
A commonly used description for professional work-related residence categories in Japan. The exact status and permitted activities must be confirmed for the role.

A residence and work route for eligible highly qualified workers in participating EU countries. Conditions are set by the relevant country; it is not unrestricted permission to work throughout Europe.
An employment route for eligible qualified workers. Check the particular German route, qualification requirements and job offer rather than relying only on this general label.
An assessment of how a foreign qualification relates to local requirements. Whether it is needed, and who performs it, depends on the profession and employment route.
A Saudi residence document. Confirm the employer’s responsibilities and applicable work and residence permissions for the individual case.
Terms often used in UAE employment discussions. Check the current official process for the job offer, contract, entry or residence and permission to work.
A UAE policy concerning employment of UAE nationals. Employers should check the current rules that apply to their establishment with the relevant authority.
A Polish national visa category. For work, check the official work-related document requirements; it is not a general authorisation to work anywhere in the EU.
An Israeli work-visa category. Confirm the prior approval and occupation-specific procedure; caregiving has a separate process from the general consular guidance.
The residence identity card issued in Qatar once the residence permit is completed. Confirm the employer’s responsibilities and the steps required after arrival.
An approval the employer obtains in Oman before an employment visa is requested for a specific profession. Check that the profession on the documents matches the job offered.
A term commonly used for private-sector work residence in Kuwait. Confirm the current category and the employer’s work permit through official channels.
A work permit issued by Bahrain’s Labour Market Regulatory Authority. Workers can verify their permit status with the authority; a visit visa is not permission to work.
Portugal’s agency for integration, migration and asylum, which handles residence permits. Confirm the current appointment and document requirements through official channels.
A Czech permit that combines residence and permission to work in a specific job. A change of job or employer may need to be notified or approved.
An approval the employer obtains in Romania before the worker applies for a long-stay employment visa. Check the current process with the Romanian authorities.
An electronic record that a licensed UK sponsor assigns to a worker for a specific job. It is a requirement for the application, not a visa or a guarantee of approval.
A UK work route for eligible occupations with a licensed sponsor. Check the current occupation, salary and English-language rules on GOV.UK.
An official invitation arranged by the employer in Russia, needed to apply for a work visa. Confirm the invitation and work permit details with the consular authority.
Official confirmation that a document is genuine so it can be used abroad. The authorities involved depend on the document and the destination.

A certificate that authenticates a public document for use in countries that are party to the Hague Apostille Convention. Whether an apostille or embassy attestation applies depends on the destination.
A certificate about a person’s criminal record status, requested by many destinations. Confirm which issuing authority and validity period the destination accepts.
Indian passport categories: Emigration Check Required and Emigration Check Not Required. ECR passport holders need emigration clearance before travelling for work to certain notified countries.
An approval from India’s Protector of Emigrants, processed through the eMigrate system, for ECR passport holders travelling for work to notified countries.
A health examination required by many destinations before a work or residence permit is issued. The tests and approved centres are set by the destination.
An arrangement in which a separate entity is the legal employer under applicable local rules. This definition does not establish that Aaroham offers an EOR service.
A contractual provision for replacement support, if agreed. Eligibility, exclusions, duration and responsibilities must be stated in the actual service agreement.
A recruitment principle under which the employer bears recruitment fees and related costs. Ask for a clear written fee allocation; this definition is not a statement of an unverified company policy.
